_meta.session: Zero-coverage ECI model backfill — 5 models (Qwen2.5-Max, Qwen3-Max, Llama 3.2 90B Vision, Mistral Medium 3, GLM-4.6) had ZERO contributing benchmark coverage. Strict attribution: only ingested values whose primary vendor source (model card, blog, paper) explicitly states the model + benchmark + numeric value in extractable text. Vendor blogs that publish numbers only as image tables (Qwen2.5-Max blog, Qwen3-Max blog, Mistral Medium 3 blog, GLM-4.6 blog) yielded no text-extractable scores and are deliberately omitted to avoid tertiary-source contamination.
